name: life-tracker
description: Life Tracker - Track expenses, splits, recurring bills, and reminders

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r index.html manifest.json sw.js privacy.html oauth-native.html icons js life-tracker-logo.png dist/ && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let c=fs.readFileSync('dist/sw.js','utf8'); c=c.replace(/CACHE_NAME = '.*?'/, 'CACHE_NAME = \'life-tracker-v' + Date.now() + '\''); fs.writeFileSync('dist/sw.js', c);"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:copy: npm run build && npx cap copy android
scripts.build:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ./life-tracker.apk && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ./app-debug.apk
